Home.heroSubtitle: TraderMemos is a self-hosted trading journal — dashboard, P&L calendar, trade log, playbook, and reports on your own infrastructure. No subscription, no vendor lock-in.
Home.featuresSub: From broker CSV to daily review — every step of the loop lives in one self-hosted app.
Home.whyBody: Cloud journals like TradeZella and TraderSync are polished — but your edge lives in the data. TraderMemos follows the same self-hosting philosophy as Ghost, Umami, and Plane: run it on your infrastructure, own the database, extend without permission.

Privacy.metaDescription: TraderMemos collects nothing. Your trades live on the server you run — here is exactly what the apps store, send, and ask permission for.
Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: TraderMemos is open-source, self-hosted software. There is no TraderMemos cloud — the mobile and web apps talk only to a server that you, or whoever set up your instance, control. We run no service that receives your trading data, and the apps ship with no analytics, advertising, or crash-reporting SDKs.

scope.title: What this policy covers
body: This policy applies to the TraderMemos apps for iOS and Android, the TraderMemos web app, and this website.
It does not cover the server you connect to. That server is run by you, or by the person who set it up for you, under their own arrangements for hosting, backups, and security.

controller.title: Who is responsible for your data
body: Because TraderMemos is self-hosted, the operator of your instance is responsible for the data in it. If you run your own server, that is you.
The publisher of the apps has no access to your instance, no credentials for it, and no way to read, export, or delete anything stored there.

device.title: What the app stores on your device
body: Your sign-in token is stored in the iOS Keychain or the Android Keystore.
Your server address, your app preferences, and a cache of recently loaded trades and reports are kept in the app's private storage, so screens open instantly and stay readable offline.
All of it stays on the device. Deleting the app removes it.

permissions.title: Device permissions
body: Photos — only if you use screenshot import. The images you pick are sent to your own server to extract fills; the app never scans your library.
Reminders — only if you bookmark an economic release. The event title and time are written to your Reminders app; nothing is read back.
Files — only when you import a CSV or JSON fill file that you choose yourself.
Each permission is requested at the moment you use the feature, and every one is optional. The app does not use the camera, location, contacts, microphone, or health data.

server.title: What the app sends to your server
body: Everything you enter — trades, executions, notes, tags, playbook rules, attachments, and your account email and password — is sent to the server address you configure, over HTTPS when your server is set up with TLS.
It is stored in that server's database, under the control of whoever operates it. No copy is sent anywhere else.

ai.title: Optional AI features
body: Screenshot fill extraction and the trade coach are off by default and are configured server-side by whoever runs your instance.

When they are switched on, the screenshots or trade details involved are sent from your server to the OpenAI-compatible endpoint that operator configured — which may be a commercial provider such as OpenAI or OpenRouter, or a model running on their own machine. That provider's own privacy terms then apply to what it receives.
If the features are left off, nothing leaves your server.

thirdParties.title: No trackers, no telemetry
body: The apps contain no advertising SDKs, no analytics SDKs, and no crash-reporting SDKs. Nothing is shared with data brokers.
The apps never contact a server operated by TraderMemos — there is no telemetry, no usage reporting, no remote configuration, and no account with us to create.

website.title: This website
body: This site is a static documentation and marketing site. It sets no advertising or tracking cookies, and fonts are served from this domain rather than a third party.

It may run Umami, a cookie-less, privacy-preserving analytics tool that records aggregate page views without profiling visitors or storing personal data. Requesting a page also involves your IP address reaching our hosting provider, as with any website.

children.title: Children
body: TraderMemos is a tool for adults journaling their own trading. It is not directed at children, and since we collect no data at all, we hold none belonging to a child.

rights.title: Your data, your control
body: Because your data lives on your own server, you do not need to ask us for access, correction, export, or deletion — you already hold it. Trades can be edited or deleted in the app, and the whole database can be exported or destroyed directly.
Uninstalling the app removes everything it stored on your device, including your sign-in token. To close an account on an instance run by someone else, contact that operator.
We cannot fulfil data requests for a server we do not operate, because we hold no copy of your data.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
body: If this policy changes materially, the date at the top of this page is updated. Because the site is open source, the full revision history of this page is public in the Git repository.

Privacy.contactBody: Questions about this policy, or about how the apps handle data, are welcome in the public repository:

FeaturePages.metaDescription: The five pillars of TraderMemos: self-hosted data ownership, behavioral analytics, prop-firm mode, rule compliance, and AI with your own keys.
FeaturePages.heading: What cloud journals can't copy
FeaturePages.sub: Five pillars, each one possible because the journal runs on your server instead of somebody’s cloud.

self-hosted.metaDescription: Your trades in a SQLite file on your own server. Docker Compose install, AGPL-3.0, no telemetry, no subscription.
self-hosted.title: Your trades never leave your server
self-hosted.subtitle: TraderMemos runs where you run it — a Go binary and a SQLite file behind your own reverse proxy. No vendor cloud, no telemetry, nothing to cancel.
self-hosted.blurb: A Go binary and a SQLite file behind your own reverse proxy — no vendor cloud, no telemetry, nothing to cancel.

points.title: One-file database
points.body: Every trade, note, and screenshot lives in a single SQLite database you can copy, back up, and query directly. Exporting your journal is a file copy.

points.title: Deploy in minutes
points.body: One docker compose up -d on any VPS, home server, or Raspberry Pi. One-click deploys cover the web UI on Vercel, Cloudflare, and Netlify.

points.title: AGPL-3.0, forever
points.body: Free software — self-host it, modify it, run it for yourself or your firm. There is no paid tier holding your analytics hostage.

points.title: No telemetry
points.body: The apps talk to your server and nowhere else. The only thing we host is this marketing site.

behavior-analytics.metaDescription: Revenge trading, overconfidence, and loss-aversion detection — plus expectancy, SQN, and Kelly — computed from your own journal.
behavior-analytics.title: Catch the tilt before it costs you
behavior-analytics.subtitle: Beyond win rate and profit factor: TraderMemos flags revenge trades, overconfidence streaks, and loss-aversion patterns straight from your execution history.
behavior-analytics.blurb: Revenge trades, overconfidence streaks, and loss aversion — detected automatically from your execution history.

points.title: Behavior flags
points.body: Revenge trading, overconfidence after streaks, holding losers longer than winners — detected automatically and listed per session.

points.title: Stats that measure an edge
points.body: Expectancy, SQN, Kelly %, median win and loss, gross vs. net — not just the four numbers every journal shows.

points.title: Session and hour breakdowns
points.body: P&L by session, hour, weekday, hold time, and setup — find when your edge is real and when you are donating.

points.title: MAE / MFE excursion
points.body: Auto-computed excursion per trade shows how much of the move you captured and how much heat you sat through.

prop-firm-mode.metaDescription: Track evaluation drawdown, daily loss limits, and progress. Prop mode is built in and free — with alerts before you breach.
prop-firm-mode.title: Pass the eval. Keep the account.
prop-firm-mode.subtitle: Configure your firm's max drawdown and daily loss rules once; TraderMemos tracks proximity in real time and alerts you before a breach, not after.
prop-firm-mode.blurb: Drawdown proximity, daily loss limits, and alerts before a breach — for every eval and funded account.

points.title: Drawdown proximity
points.body: Live distance to your trailing or static max drawdown, on the dashboard and in your pocket.

points.title: Daily loss limits
points.body: Set the firm's daily cap; the journal warns as you approach it and records the days you respected it.

points.title: Alerts, free
points.body: Push and webhook alerts fire from your own server. No Pro tier stands between you and a breach warning.

points.title: Every account, one journal
points.body: Evals, funded accounts, and personal accounts side by side — each with its own rules.

rule-compliance.metaDescription: Write your risk rules once; every trade is checked against them. See what following your rules is actually worth in P&L.
rule-compliance.title: Your rules, enforced by your journal
rule-compliance.subtitle: Max risk per trade, max trades per day, stop required, no adding to losers — TraderMemos scores every trade against the rules you wrote.
rule-compliance.blurb: Write your risk rules once; every trade is scored against them, and discipline gets a dollar value.

points.title: Rules as data
points.body: Define risk rules in settings — not in a note you stop reading. Each trade gets a compliance check automatically.

points.title: Compliance impact
points.body: Reports split your P&L into rule-following and rule-breaking trades, so discipline gets a dollar value.

points.title: Broken-rule alerts
points.body: A push notification when a trade breaks a rule — while you can still do something about the next one.

points.title: Checklists and playbooks
points.body: Setups carry entry criteria; the day review asks whether you traded the plan.

ai-your-keys.metaTitle: AI trade coach with your own keys — TraderMemos
ai-your-keys.metaDescription: AI trade review and screenshot OCR import using your own OpenAI-compatible API keys. Your data goes to the provider you chose — or to none at all.
ai-your-keys.title: AI coaching without a middleman
ai-your-keys.subtitle: Bring your own OpenAI-compatible key — OpenAI, Anthropic, or a local model. The journal calls the provider you configured; there is no vendor AI between you and your data.
ai-your-keys.blurb: AI trade review and OCR import with your own OpenAI-compatible keys — including fully local models.

points.title: Your provider, your bill
points.body: Point TraderMemos at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, pay the provider directly, and swap models any time.

points.title: Trade coach
points.body: Per-trade AI review that reads your entry, exit, excursion, and notes — and asks the uncomfortable questions.

points.title: Screenshot OCR import
points.body: Snap a broker fill screen; OCR extracts the executions and prefills the trade form.

points.title: Local models welcome
points.body: Run Ollama or another local endpoint and no trade data leaves your machine at all.
